Art Portfolio.

I am a Visual Developer and 3D Generalist specialized in hard-surface modeling, technical texturing, and stylized art direction. My work ranges from meticulous prop and environment creation to full visual development of animation IPs (Character Design, Storyboarding, and Pitch Bibles). I am passionate about blending technical rigor with nostalgic aesthetics (low-poly/retro) and cinematic lighting to tell stories through every image.
